Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects stock simulation and gouge credit.

- A part-source mark receives credit only on its source parts.
- The credit uses those parts' top surfaces and undersides.
- A stock-source mark still receives credit on all setup parts.
- Empty targets receive no credit. The change has no new dependency or build script.

Local results: I merged this head with upstream/main at 703af81 in a separate worktree. The merge had no conflict. All commands ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. Sim: 171 tests passed. App: 588 tests passed; 15 tests were ignored by their existing attributes. No test failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Mutation checks:

1. I set `target: None` in `stock_sim_marks.rs`. The app regression test failed: `trace false picked false: the program sim credited B's mark on A`. After I restored the source, the same test passed.
2. I replaced the target lookup with `let part = None;` in sim `mark.rs`. Both new target tests failed: `A's columns must remain convicted` and `0.1 mm left on B's own underside must stay convicted`. After I restored the source, all 11 `mark_credit` tests passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required. I did not run the batch or release gate. I did not add a test for marks across setups with different part alignments. The source was restored after each mutation, and the trial-merge worktree is clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
